xdrivers.method: X search (relevancy, last ~3–5 days) + X news; explanations are likely, inferred, not confirmed. Tuesday morning refresh: stock moves are Monday Oct 26 closes vs Friday Oct 23 (5-day vs Oct 19) from Yahoo; Bitcoin is the last ~24 hours and 5 days to Tuesday morning.

MU.explanation: Likely: MU rose about 3.0% Monday to about $903.70 (roughly flat over 5 days) as memory came back into focus, with Bank of America turning more positive on tight supply into 2027 and 2028 and Samsung flagging a record quarterly profit. Attention now shifts to SK hynix's Q3 report on Wednesday (Seoul time), seen as a read-through for HBM demand.

sources.gist: Micron surging after Bank of America said memory supply will stay tight into 2027 and 2028
MU closed up 2.98% at $903.70 as memory got back in focus on Samsung's record profit estimate, with SK Hynix up next
Expert takeaway: Samsung quotes HBM at $4.50 vs $4.00 for Micron and $3.60–3.80 for SK Hynix
SK hynix reports Q3 on Oct 28 (Seoul); consensus implies about a 78% operating margin

SPCX.explanation: Likely: SPCX slipped about 0.4% Monday to about $146.90 (about 0.7% lower over 5 days), giving back an early pop after SpaceX locked in about $40B of GPU debt financing. A Starlink deal with easyJet and Wedbush's reiterated $225 target didn't hold the gains, as attention shifted to the retail push for a Tesla combination.

SpaceX gains on Starlink's in-flight Wi-Fi partnership with easyJet

rebellionaire.overview: Rebellionaire (rebellionaire.com) is a Tesla-focused advisory firm led by Bradford Ferguson. It writes for concentrated investors and promotes covered calls and a trim-and-add discipline. Broad views: strongly bullish on Tesla (Robotaxi, Optimus, energy). It favors a Tesla-SpaceX combination only at a fair exchange ratio, ideally after Tesla's autonomy value is priced in. It runs a SpaceX hub covering the June 12 IPO and is bullish on Micron's AI-memory profits. It is a long-time Lemonade bull, covers Upstart every quarter, and has little crypto coverage.

MU.title: What Terafab Means for Micron and the Memory Tradeade and Micron Holders
MU.author: Rebellionaire Staff
MU.summary: Terafab (Tesla/SpaceX/xAI fab; Intel joined Apr 7) plans memory as well as logic. They see no near-term hit to Micron since volume is 2027+ and HBM later. Bull case: Micron becomes the US HBM partner. Bear case: Terafab builds its own DRAM over a decade.

MU.title: Intel Joins Terafab: What It Means for Tesla Investors
MU.author: Rebellionaire Staff
MU.summary: Intel joins Terafab for design, fab and packaging. Plan: 100K wafer starts/month at pilot scaling to 1M, and 100-200B AI and memory chips a year. The $20-25B cost is not yet in Tesla's 2026 capex.

MU.title: Micron vs Tesla: The Profit Shock Nobody Sees
MU.author: Rebellionaire Staff
MU.summary: Argues Micron's next-quarter net income will top any Tesla quarter through 2030. Cites ~$24B revenue, 74.4% gross margin and $12 EPS, plus guidance of $33.5B, 81% GM and ~$19 EPS, with the stock near 4x forward P/E. Says the shortage makes memory no longer a commodity.

SPCX.title: Terafab & Orbital AI Compute: The Real Risks
SPCX.author: Rebellionaire Staff
SPCX.summary: Risk-focused piece separating two bets: Terafab (vertical integration into chipmaking) and orbital AI compute (moving workloads to space). Launch and reuse are proven; chipmaking at scale is unproven and capital-heavy.

SPCX.title: SPCX Position Sizing: A Framework for Concentrated SpaceX Holders
SPCX.author: Rebellionaire Staff
SPCX.summary: Framework for concentrated SPCX investors after the IPO: split risk into company, liquidity and behavioral, and set trim and add bands in advance rather than defaulting to diversification.

SPCX.title: SpaceX IPO S-1: What Tesla Investors Need to Know
SPCX.author: Rebellionaire Staff
SPCX.summary: S-1 readout: 2025 revenue ~$18.7B, Q1 2026 net loss ~$4.9B, Starlink ~10.3M subscribers and ~$7.2B 2025 segment EBITDA, AI segment ~$6.4B operating loss. Calls the viral claim that Tesla investors would 'only get 30%' in a combination wrong.

SPCX.title: SpaceX xAI Merger: Why Wall Street Is Paying Attention
SPCX.author: Rebellionaire Staff
SPCX.summary: SpaceX acquired xAI at ~$1T / ~$250B (~$1.25T combined), with xAI reportedly burning ~$1B a month. Bull case: internal funding. Bear case: two capital-hungry businesses stacked together.

TSLA.title: Tesla SpaceX Merger: Why Timing Matters for Tesla Shareholders
TSLA.author: Rebellionaire Staff
TSLA.summary: Backs a Tesla-SpaceX combination strategically but says the exchange ratio is everything. Tesla investors should want Robotaxi and Optimus valued before a deal, and they think the market gives Optimus near-zero credit.

TSLA.title: What If Tesla Flips the SpaceX Deal?
TSLA.author: Rebellionaire Staff
TSLA.summary: If Tesla proves Robotaxi, Optimus and AI profits first, it could enter a SpaceX deal as the stronger half. Calls Robotaxi the cleanest catalyst because it turns autonomy into revenue.

TSLA.title: Tesla’s SpaceX Problem: The Ratio Matters
TSLA.author: Rebellionaire Staff
TSLA.summary: With Tesla at ~$1.4-1.7T and SpaceX at ~$1.75T, the gap between 51% and 40% ownership matters. Musk's >50% SpaceX voting control makes the ratio the key fairness test.

TSLA.title: Tesla's Biggest Fixable Weakness Isn't the Car
TSLA.author: Rebellionaire Staff
TSLA.summary: Optimus production at Fremont late Jul/Aug 2026, with Giga Texas volume ~summer 2027. 2025 energy revenue $12.8B (+27%), 46.7 GWh deployed. Argues vague timelines are a fixable drag on valuation.

TSLA.title: How Tesla Plans to Mass-Produce the Cybercab Without the 2,500-Unit Cap
TSLA.author: Rebellionaire Staff
TSLA.summary: Explains how a 2022 NHTSA rule could let the wheel-less Cybercab scale past the 2,500-unit exemption cap. Production was targeted for Q2 2026. Relevant to the current NHTSA certification probe.

LMND.title: Berkshire’s AI Blind Spot in Insurance
LMND.author: Rebellionaire Staff
LMND.summary: Uses Ajit Jain's AI comments to argue legacy insurers trail AI-first Lemonade, since small-premium policies can't absorb human claim handling.

LMND.title: Lemonade Offering Tesla Autonomous Insurance
LMND.author: Rebellionaire Staff
LMND.summary: Lemonade launched autonomous car insurance starting with Tesla FSD, with per-mile rates ~50% lower for FSD-engaged miles, priced from vehicle data.

LMND.title: Everyone’s Looking for the Next Tesla—Here’s What They Miss
LMND.author: Rebellionaire Staff
LMND.summary: After Lemonade's $20-to-$60 run, argues the next leg comes from improving loss ratios, newer lines and operating leverage.

LMND.title: Inside Lemonade’s AI Automation Shift in Tel Aviv
LMND.author: Rebellionaire Staff
LMND.summary: Community notes from a Tel Aviv event: >60% of support tickets and ~57% of claims handled end-to-end by AI (event notes, not company filings).

UPST.title: Upstart Q1 2026: Strong Quarter, Messy Message
UPST.author: Henry Dierkes
UPST.summary: Q1 2026: revenue $308M (+44%), originations $3.4B (+61%), GAAP loss of $0.07 per share, adj. EBITDA $40.5M, contribution margin down from 55% to 50%. Full-year guidance reaffirmed.

UPST.title: Upstart Q1 2026 Results: Strong, Messy, Misread
UPST.author: Henry Dierkes
UPST.summary: Says Q1 was stronger than the market reaction implied; reaffirmed guidance was the biggest positive. Debate centers on EPS, balance-sheet loans and communication.

UPST.title: Upstart Q1 2026 Preview: All Systems Gu?
UPST.author: Henry Dierkes
UPST.summary: Q4 2025 recap: revenue $296M (+35%), GAAP net income $18.6M, balance-sheet loans cut $245M, 70% of auto and HELOC funding from partners.

UPST.title: It's Gu Time: A Conversation With Upstart's Incoming CEO
UPST.author: Henry Dierkes
UPST.summary: Interview with incoming CEO Paul Gu covering Model 25, the Upstart Macro Index (est. to have avoided ~80% of 2022 disruption), his ~$4M open-market stock purchase and ~35% annual compounding guidance.

BTC-USD.title: Fed Ends Special Crypto Oversight Program

BTC-USD.title: Crypto Chaos: Tesla, Bitcoin, and the Market Freakout
BTC-USD.author: Rebellionaire Staff
BTC-USD.summary: Feb 2025 market recap: crypto selloff alongside a $1.5B Ethereum heist, Tesla dipping below $300, and FSD's China rollout.

BTC-USD.title: Trump's U.S. Crypto Reserve: Strategic Genius or Just More Chaos?
BTC-USD.author: Rebellionaire Staff
BTC-USD.summary: Weighs the proposed US crypto reserve: strategic support for digital assets versus more government control of the market.
